title: Microsoft Edge: in-context site troubleshooting controls for broken websites
notes: claim 62: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Pass with gaps: the roadmap facts and existing tracking-prevention controls are supported, but staying on the current page and visibility only on broken sites are not documented. The policy paths need their scope headings, and the claim about disabling the prompt should be narrowed to feature-specific controls. Historical instructions addressed to the verifier were ignored.
